title: Water Seepages and Wear and Tear Problems at Common Areas of HDB Estates
what_it_is: Water Seepages and Wear and Tear Problems at Common Areas of HDB Estates

sections.label: Town Council wall maintenance duties
sections.summary: Town Councils must keep common property including external walls in good condition, and HDB assists with inspections, advice, training and dialogues.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Town Councils are responsible for keeping common property, including external walls, in good condition by carrying out regular and cyclical maintenance.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: For difficult cases, HDB will work with the Town Councils to resolve the seepage issue.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: In such cases, HDB can assist the Town Council by carrying out joint inspections and providing technical advice to the Town Council on appropriate repair methods.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: In addition, to support Town Councils in carrying out their maintenance work, HDB has been providing training to Town Council maintenance staff on the repairs of water seepage from external walls.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: There are also regular dialogues between HDB and Town Councils to discuss and resolve issues relating to estate maintenance.
